pull.title: doc: Fix Doxygen attribution of file-level comments
pull.body: Doxygen attaches a comment block that lacks a `@file` command to the next declaration rather than to the file. For example: This PR fixes that. Requested in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36805#discussion_r4511737767: > ... they are wrong, ... it may be best to fix them instead of ignoring them? Required for https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36805.

Doxygen attached it to `EncodeBase58()`. Use `//` so Doxygen ignores it.

doc: Attach `subprocess.h` header comment to the file

Add `@file` and `@brief` so Doxygen documents the file rather than the
`subprocess_close` macro.

Also move the whole comment block inside the include guard. This
simplifies upcoming changes to the include guard linter.

> If the idea is to consolidate these (onto one style?) looks like a number were missed...

The initial motivation was to remove all comments that start with `/*` from between a copyright banner and an include guard to simplify the linter code in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36805.

This PR provides the minimal diff to achieve that aim.

And these changes are real fixes for the Doxygen-generated docs rather than pure style changes.

comments.body: Sure, but we could include the design note in the docs, rather than hiding it? i.e something like: ```diff diff --git a/src/base58.h b/src/base58.h index bca3c07701..65ac61f1ac 100644 --- a/src/base58.h +++ b/src/base58.h @@ -4,6 +4,9 @@ // file COPYING or http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php. /** + * @file + * Base58 and Base58Check encoding and decoding. + * * Why base-58 instead of standard base-64 encoding? * - Don't want 0OIl characters that look the same in some fonts and * could be used to create visually identical looking data. ```
